channel.title: Austin Daily Herald - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Austin Daily Herald (austindailyherald.com)

item.title: Wings score late goal off face-off to beat Bruins
item.description: Cooper Anderson's late faceoff goal lifted the Aberdeen Wings to a 2-1 win over division-leading Austin Bruins at Riverside Arena; Siamion Marshchanok scored Austin's lone goal.

item.title: Shorthanded Packer boys close season with loss at Mayo
item.description: Shorthanded Austin boys fall 84-45 at Mayo in regular-season finale; two seniors sidelined as Packers turn focus to Section 1AAA tournament opener Wednesday.

item.title: Blue Devil men advance to Region XIII championship
item.description: Riverland men top Anoka-Ramsey 85-75 behind Camden Fearon's 19 and Joe Poyser's double-double to reach the Region XIII title game vs. Ridgewater on Sunday in Anoka.

item.title: Austin's Dahl advances in two events at state swim meet
item.description: Austin’s Brent Dahl reaches Class AA state finals in 100 backstroke and 200 IM consolation; Packer 200 medley relay narrowly misses advancing at U of M prelims.

item.title: Symphony of gratitude
item.description: AHS orchestra to play commissioned piece honoring Phil Burkhart.

item.title: GMLOS's Meyer takes sixth at 235 at state meet
item.description: GMLOS junior Kloe Meyer places sixth at 235 pounds at the Class A state meet, while teammates Chloe Hubbard and Brandy Christenson close seasons in wrestlebacks.

item.title: Paint power: Vikings use inside attack to beat Southland, advance to Section 1A title game
item.description: Hayfield/Schaeffer leans on inside attack from seniors Lilly Morrisey and Avi Alexander to top Southland 61-51 and earn a shot at New Richland-HEG in the Section 1A final.

item.title: Austin's Dahl takes second in backstroke at state meet
item.description: Austin senior Brent Dahl caps Packer career with runner-up finish in 100 backstroke at Class AA state meet, posting Automatic All American time and committing to Southern Illinois next year.

item.title: Two-vehicles crash leaves Iowa woman dead
item.description: Iowa woman killed, two hurt in fiery two-vehicle crash in Mower County; sheriff says weather and road conditions are believed to be factors as investigation continues.

item.title: Bruins bring down Wings with first period surge
item.description: First-period goals from Michael Coleman and EJ Paddington and 24 saves by Cody Butikis lifted the Austin Bruins to a 3-1 win over the Aberdeen Wings at Riverside Arena.
